concept.title: Five things to know
concept.shortdesc: The five ideas behind uFTi, in two minutes.

section.title: A workspace is one family tree
section.p: You can have more than one. is a sample workspace to practise in. Your own tree goes in a workspace you make.

section.title: People and families
section.p: Add a person for each relative. A family joins a couple and their children. Join people into families, and draws the tree for you.

section.title: Facts and sources
section.p: A fact is something you record, such as a birth with its date. A source is where you found it. It can be a certificate, a census page, or what someone told you. Add a source to each fact. Then you will always know why you believe it.

section.title: Saving and copies
section.p: saves your work as you go. To keep it safe, make a copy. Export your tree as a file and keep it somewhere else. Do it again after a big session.

section.title: Getting help
section.p: Choose on any screen to read about it. Practise in the sample workspace first.
